add_definitions(
    -DWIN32
    -DNDEBUG=
    -D_WINDOWS
    -DPNG_BUILD_DLL
    -DPNG_ARM_NEON_OPT=0)

include_directories(
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/libpng/include
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/zlib/include)

spec2def(libpng.dll libpng.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# libpng.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/libpng-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(libpng_shims OBJECT png.c pngerror.c pngget.c pngmem.c pngpread.c pngread.c pngrio.c pngrtran.c pngrutil.c pngset.c pngtrans.c pngwio.c pngwrite.c pngwtran.c pngwutil.c)
target_link_libraries(libpng_shims PRIVATE zlib libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_cargo_module(libpng libpng-cargo libpng.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS libpng_shims psdk)
